meta.subject: Bahasa Melayu
meta.purpose: Connect curriculum evidence to diagnostic confidence, mastery evidence and intervention without replacing teacher professional judgement for official PBD Tahap Penguasaan.

mastery_model.separation_rule: AI mastery score, AI suggested TP evidence and teacher-confirmed TP are separate fields.

confidence_levels.medium: repeated evidence but limited task diversity
confidence_levels.high: repeated, recent and cross-task evidence with clear attribution

TP1.system_interpretation: very limited evidence of the targeted skill; substantial guidance typically required

TP2.system_interpretation: limited/basic evidence; learner can perform parts of the skill with support

TP3.system_interpretation: adequate/basic independent performance is observable in familiar tasks

TP4.system_interpretation: good and generally consistent application across appropriate tasks

TP5.system_interpretation: very good, detailed and consistent application across varied tasks

TP6.system_interpretation: excellent, highly consistent, detailed and transferable performance that may serve as an example

audio_required: listening discrimination when no teacher mark directly evidences it
evidence_policy.uncertain_ocr: store as uncertain and exclude from confirmed weakness calculations until verified
evidence_policy.teacher_mark_override: teacher-confirmed marking has priority over automatic visual inference of correctness

weakness_states.possible_weakness: same micro-skill has repeated errors but evidence is still narrow
weakness_states.confirmed_weakness: repeated errors across independent items/tasks with adequate attribution
weakness_states.persistent_weakness: confirmed weakness persists across different dates or task sources
weakness_states.improving_weakness: previous weakness with clear recent improvement
weakness_states.resolved_monitoring: recent independent evidence indicates mastery, but continue periodic checking

root_cause_rules: Prefer the narrowest defensible micro-skill rather than diagnosing an entire domain.
Do not label a learner weak in Tatabahasa because of one spelling slip.
If the same underlying rule fails in explicit grammar tasks and authentic writing, raise confidence in the grammar diagnosis.
If the learner identifies content correctly but cannot justify it, diagnose justification rather than content identification.
If an answer is wrong because the instruction was misunderstood, separate task interpretation from subject knowledge.
When multiple causes remain plausible, retain multiple hypotheses with lower confidence rather than forcing one diagnosis.

remediation_engine.success_condition: Improvement must be demonstrated on later independent evidence; immediate correction alone does not close the weakness.

longitudinal_logic.recent_weighting: recent independent evidence should influence current mastery more than old evidence, while persistent historical weaknesses remain visible
longitudinal_logic.cross_source_bonus: same skill demonstrated across workbook, school worksheet, test or authentic writing increases confidence
longitudinal_logic.recovery_logic: move confirmed/persistent weakness to improving only after better independent evidence; move to resolved_monitoring only after repeated success
longitudinal_logic.regression_logic: a previously mastered skill may reopen when multiple recent independent errors appear
